jobs.title: Performance & Capability Design, Program Manager
jobs.description:
Posting Date
10/01/2026

300 First Executive AveSte A, St Peters, Missouri, 63376-1655, United States of America

Performance & Capability Design, Program Manager
Location: Remote or Denver Hybrid (Preferred)
The Opportunity
We are transforming how DaVita builds workforce capability, aligning our approach with personalized development strategies and the future of learning. We are moving beyond traditional training order-taking to build a Performance & Capability Design function that solves business problems through strategic learning consulting and high-level learning solution design, while maintaining a holistic view of the tools, processes, and environment.
We are seeking a Program Manager, Performance & Capability Design to support this transformation. This is a strategic learning consulting and project leadership role. You will manage large-scale projects aimed at diagnosing the organization's most complex capability challenges. Working alongside performance architects and business leaders, you will consult on and create high-level designs for innovative learning solutions that directly impact our clinical and business outcomes.
An ideal candidate will be proficient in performance and learning consulting with a proven track record of designing and implementing holistic enablement and capability solutions.
Your Impact
As a key member of the team, you will:
- Execute the Personalized Learning Strategy: Shift the organization toward the future of learning by managing enablement initiatives that focus on personalized, impactful development aligned with DaVita’s highest-priority business goals.
- Drive Learning & Business Results: Track and report on impact metrics (clinical and business performance outcomes, pipeline readiness, and retention) while evaluating the effectiveness of modern learning interventions.
- Consult & Design: Partner with stakeholders to diagnose performance gaps and design high-level learning solutions, maintaining an awareness of how process, technology, or environment impact the learner experience.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities
Learning Consulting & Stakeholder Engagement
- Strategic Partnership: Serve as a learning consultant to operational and clinical leaders. Help translate their business strategy into clear workforce capability requirements and personalized development journeys.
- Needs Analysis: Conduct performance gap and learning needs analyses to ensure we are solving the right problems. Recommend targeted, modern learning interventions rather than one-size-fits-all training.

High-Level Solution Design
- Learning Architecture: Lead the high-level design of blended learning solutions. Architect programs that leverage the future of learning (e.g., personalized pathways, microlearning, learning in the flow of work) while considering workflow support and technology adoption.
- Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner with instructional designers, technologists, and SMEs to translate high-level learning designs into effective, scalable development programs.

Project Management & Execution
- Project Leadership: Manage large-scale, medium- to high-complexity learning consulting projects from inception to implementation. Align business and delivery lanes to implement solutions that drive behavioral change.
- Change Management: Support change management required to shift stakeholder expectations from "requesting traditional training" to "partnering on personalized learning and performance."

Minimum Qualifications
- 3-5+ years of progressive experience in Learning Consulting, Learning Design, Organizational Effectiveness, or related field.
- Experience with Human Performance Technology (HPT) or similar methodologies.
- Experience project managing complex learning and capability initiatives across matrixed teams, including senior stakeholder management.
- Proficient in building presentation decks that clearly visualize data and design concepts.
- Prefer Denver, CO-based (in-office downtown Tues/Wed/Thurs); open to remote for the right candidate.
- Travel required: up to 5-10%

We are building a new, integrated care model to support patients with kidney disease. Historically, kidney patients have navigated a complex and frustrating healthcare system, but we are building a better way which treats the patient holistically. If you want to help lead to a better future for kidney patients, then you may be a great fit for the Regional Operations Manager role with DaVita Integrated Kidney Care (IKC).

jobs.title: Clinical Support Sr Program Manager
jobs.description:
Posting Date
10/05/2026

2000 16th Street, Denver, Colorado, 80202, United States of America

Denver, CO (Hybrid In-Person / Remote)

As a Sr. Manager on the IKC Clinical Programs team, you will play a pivotal role in driving the operational design, launch, and scaling of innovative care delivery models along with supporting the migration of our electronic medical record (EMR) in 2027. DaVita Integrated Kidney Care (IKC) delivers comprehensive, wrap-around value-based kidney care with the goal of improving health outcomes, elevating patient quality of life, and reducing unnecessary healthcare costs.

This role serves as a vital operational and strategic driver of work, as well as a thought partner for the DaVita Medical Home (DMH) and DaVita Care Central (DCC) programs. You will help craft, execute, and advance the back-end support infrastructure that integrates comprehensive primary care, routine clinical management, and advanced practice providers (APPs / NPs)—both internal clinical staff and external partner networks—directly into dialysis centers nationwide. You will also bring a strong organizational backbone to strategic leadership forums for our EMR migration work, connecting dots across care delivery workstreams and other parts of the broader organization (IT, Product, Training, Communications, etc.).

The Sr. Manager, Clinical Programs & Operations (DMH / DCC) will drive essential work for two business-critical projects: DaVita Medical Home work and IKC's Migration to a new EMR: Epic. This individual will be the engine that drives operationalization of DMH work, playing a key role in helping to craft, operationalize, and advance the strategic plan while directly driving back-end setup and day-to-day execution. This is a highly dynamic role that spans multiple strategic initiatives for the value-based care business and requires adaptability, a bias-to-action and the desire to carve concrete work out of ambiguity.

This role bridges clinical strategy, technology enablement, billing operations, and cross-functional governance. You will own critical workstreams to translate clinical care models into functional operational workflows across clinical systems (OneView, CWOW, and the enterprise Epic transition), support establishment of compliant billing and documentation pathways for Fee-For-Service (FFS) care management programs (CCM, PCM, TCM), and partner closely with multidisciplinary teams across Legal, Compliance, Privacy, Credentialing, and Clinical Risk.

Key Responsibilities

1. DMH & DCC Program Operationalization & Expansion
- Program Scaling & Execution: Partner with Directors and leadership to shape, refine, and advance operational execution plans, scaling DMH and DCC programs from initial pilot clinics to national scale.
- Provider Integration & Clinic Readiness: Operationalize the integration of Primary Care Providers (PCPs) and Nurse Practitioners (NPs)—both internal staff and external partner networks—into dialysis centers. Establish clinic onboarding checklists, day-in-the-life workflows, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).

2. Back-End Systems & Technology Infrastructure (Epic, OneView, CWOW)
- Operational Requirements & System Workflows: Partner closely with Product Management (OneView, CWOW, Epic) and IT to define, prioritize, and validate operational requirements for provider access, patient-to-provider relationship mapping, and clinical documentation flow.
- Access Governance & Data Continuity: Enforce operational access controls to maintain patient privacy standards, while ensuring clinical encounter notes and orders flow downstream seamlessly to CWOW, Epic, and repository systems (P8).
- Epic Transition Enablement: Support the migration of DMH/DCC clinical workflows and tools into the enterprise Epic platform, tracking build dependencies, operational action items, and trade-off recommendations for leadership.

3. Care Management Billing & Revenue Cycle Infrastructure
- FFS Billing Setup & Quality Checks: Help establish, manage, and monitor the operational prerequisites and audit-ready tracking necessary to compliantly bill Medicare Fee-For-Service programs (CCM, PCM, TCM, CHEs).
- Cross-Functional Billing Alignment: Coordinate with Revenue Operations, Finance, Actuarial, and Compliance to establish billing capture protocols, resolve co-pay handling/waiver workflows, and assess FFS vs. risk-adjustment implications.

4. Cross-Functional Governance & Operational SOPs
- Multidisciplinary Coordination: Serve as a central operational liaison across Legal, Regulatory, Compliance, Privacy (LCPR), Credentialing, and Clinical Risk to execute provider onboarding requirements, supervisory frameworks, and risk mitigations.
- Lifecycle Management & Change Enablement: Develop, document, and maintain SOPs for provider lifecycle events (credentialing verification, supervising physician links, provider offboarding, patient reassignment) and partner with clinical training teams on field job aids.

5. Program Monitoring, Leadership Support & Continuous Improvement
- Performance & KPI Tracking: Track and analyze operational metrics, enrollment figures, provider utilization, clinical documentation timeliness, and process adherence to provide regular visibility to leadership.
- Leadership Support & Thought Partnership: Partner with Directors and the Ops VP to draft executive summaries, synthesize operational data, prepare risk rundowns, and formulate options/trade-offs for leadership forums (Steering Committees, COO Reviews, Summit presentations).
- Process Optimization: Proactively identify workflow bottlenecks, escalate operational risks, and execute iterative process enhancements to support scalable growth.

Qualifications & Experience

Education & Experience
- Education: Bachelor’s degree ideally in one of the following categories: Healthcare Administration, Business, Public Health, or related field required.
- Experience: 5–7+ years of progressive experience in healthcare operations, clinical program management, health systems consulting, or healthcare technology implementation.
- Value-Based & Primary Care Knowledge: Proven understanding of value-based care (VBC) models, integrated care coordination, and Medicare care management programs (CCM, PCM, TCM, CHEs).
- EHR & Technical Literacy: Demonstrated experience working with EHR/EMR platforms (Epic, CWOW, OneView, or equivalent clinical systems) and collaborating with technical product teams to operationalize clinical workflows.

Skills & Competencies
- Strategic Problem Solving: Strong structured problem-solving skills with the ability to navigate ambiguous environments, translate strategic concepts into tactical operational workflows, and evaluate complex trade-offs.
- Cross-Functional Leadership: Demonstrated track record of building alignment across diverse internal and external stakeholders, including physicians, clinical risk, legal/compliance, engineering, and field leadership.
- Process Engineering & SOP Development: Expertise in designing scalable workflows, drafting clear standard operating procedures, and establishing operational governance frameworks.
- Communication & Executive Presentation: Excellent written and verbal communication skills; adept at synthesizing complex operational data into concise presentations for senior leadership.
- Appetite for Ambiguity : Effective at self-starting on occasion; desire to take ownership over workstreams and exercise own judgement to make improvements where you see opportunity.

- DaVita Values: Strong commitment to DaVita’s Core Values: Service Excellence, Integrity, Team, Continuous Improvement, Accountability, Fulfillment, and Fun.

Senior Director, Transformation

DaVita is a rapidly growing Healthcare Services company driven by the unwavering pursuit of a healthier tomorrow. As a key driver to enable our vision and financial/operating performance, our Revenue Cycle team serves as trusted patient advocates and world-class revenue partners in order to reduce burden and maximize yield.

About the Role
DaVita is seeking a transformational technology and product leader to drive the modernization of one of our most critical enterprise capabilities—Revenue Operations (ROPS). This executive will lead product strategy and business transformation for the proprietary platforms that power billing, collections, cash posting, and other core revenue cycle functions that are essential to DaVita's financial performance.

This role sits at the intersection of business strategy, technology modernization, and organizational change. The Senior Director will shape the long-term vision for a portfolio of internal platforms while leading a large-scale transformation of legacy technologies into a modern, cloud-based ecosystem leveraging Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Palantir Foundry, advanced analytics, automation, and AI-powered capabilities.

As a trusted partner to both business and technology leadership, this individual will serve as the critical bridge between Revenue Operations leaders and DaVita's IT product, engineering, architecture, data, and platform teams. They will translate business strategy into technology roadmaps, ensure investment decisions are aligned to measurable value, and drive enterprise adoption of modern ways of working.

This leader will oversee a multi-year transformation effort impacting thousands of teammates, billions of dollars in annual revenue cycle activity, and the platforms that enable one of the largest healthcare revenue cycle organizations in the country.

Key Responsibilities

Technology Transformation & Product Strategy
- Define and execute the strategic vision and roadmap for DaVita's core Revenue Operations technology ecosystem.
- Lead the modernization of proprietary revenue cycle applications supporting billing, collections, cash posting, reimbursement, and financial operations.
- Partner with IT architecture and engineering leadership to guide a multi-year migration of legacy applications and data assets to Google Cloud Platform and modern cloud-native architectures.
- Influence enterprise technology investment decisions, balancing innovation, operational efficiency, scalability, security, and business value.
- Develop platform strategies that leverage Palantir Foundry, advanced analytics, AI, automation, APIs, and modern data architectures to improve performance and decision-making.
- Establish product operating models and governance processes that align business priorities with technology execution.

AI, Automation & Digital Innovation

- Translate complex business challenges into actionable product and technology strategies.
- Build strong partnerships with senior leaders across Operations, Finance, Technology, Data, Analytics, Architecture, Compliance, and Product organizations.
- Facilitate alignment across business and technical stakeholders on priorities, roadmap sequencing, investment tradeoffs, and transformation objectives.
- Represent revenue cycle business needs in enterprise technology planning and architecture discussions.

- Build organizational capabilities in product management, business transformation, process modernization, and technology strategy.
- Create an environment that encourages collaboration, accountability, innovation, and customer-centric thinking.

Business Outcomes & Value Realization
- Define success metrics and value realization frameworks for major transformation investments.
- Monitor platform adoption, operational efficiency, financial performance, user experience, and technology health.

jobs.title: IKC Clinical Programs Program Manager
jobs.description:

2000 16th Street, Denver, Colorado, 80202, United States of America

The Manager, CKD MA Panel Management leads the day-to-day design, deployment, performance management, and continuous improvement of DaVita Integrated Kidney Care’s Chronic Kidney Disease Medicare Advantage (CKD MA) panel management capability. Panel management is both a tool and an operating process that brings together patient priorities across data sources, organizes work by the action expected from the care team, and helps teams focus on timely, actionable opportunities that can improve clinical and Tier 1 metric outcomes.

This manager owns an aspect of the CKD clinical programs functional area and translates broader CKD MA goals into measurable deliverables for the team. The role connects clinical priorities, operations, analytics, technology, training, and nephrology-facing workflows. It requires a hands-on leader who can establish a durable management process, resolve ambiguity, build cross-functional alignment, and move work from design through implementation, reinforcement, and scale.

Primary mandate: Create a reliable, scalable operating system for CKD MA panel management, with clear workflows, usable tools, strong adoption, measurable performance, and sustained field execution.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

- Program ownership and operating model. Own the CKD MA panel management workstream end to end, including roadmap, governance, milestones, decision rights, risks, dependencies, and the ongoing management cadence.
- Workflow and tool evolution. Translate clinical and operational requirements into prioritized tool and workflow enhancements; lead requirements definition, user acceptance testing, issue resolution, and integration with enterprise technology and reporting partners.
- Performance management. Define leading and lagging indicators, establish baseline and target views, monitor adoption and execution, identify performance barriers, and lead action planning with market and functional partners.
- Deployment and change management. Plan and lead pilots, phased launches, training, reinforcement, office hours, field support, and transition to steady-state operations. Anticipate the impact of changes and build buy-in across stakeholders.
- Clinical-program integration. Ensure panel management supports CKD MA clinical and quality priorities, including nephrology visit optimization, data density, medication management, Stars care gaps, Optimal Starts, and Delay Progression, while keeping ownership and workflows clear.
- Cross-functional leadership. Coordinate across clinical, operations, analytics, product/technology, training, market leadership, care pods, nephrology-facing teams, and payer-facing partners. Surface trade-offs, secure decisions, and resolve misalignment with limited supervision.
- Executive communication. Synthesize complex operational, clinical, and performance information into concise recommendations, status updates, decision materials, and leadership readouts.
- Team leadership and development. Set clear objectives and expectations, delegate work, drive accountability for results, coach teammates, and create an inclusive environment in which people can contribute, learn, and grow.
- Continuous improvement. Use teammate and stakeholder feedback, workflow observation, data trends, and root-cause analysis to improve the tool, process, resources, and management system over time.
- Future program readiness. As the CKD MA operating model stabilizes, extend the capability to support evolving contracts, payer requirements, and related CKD clinical programs without losing execution discipline.

What Success Looks Like

- A single, understood operating process connects patient prioritization to care-team and nephrology action.
- Field teams have the access, training, tools, job aids, and reinforcement needed to execute consistently.
- Adoption, data quality, workflow completion, and outcome measures are visible through a repeatable performance-management cadence.
- Tool and workflow enhancements are prioritized against business value, user need, clinical intent, effort, and risk.
- Leaders receive clear insights, trade-offs, recommendations, and escalation paths rather than status reporting alone.
- Cross-functional partners understand ownership, decisions are documented, and implementation risks are addressed early.
- Direct reports have clear goals, meaningful ownership, regular feedback, and development plans.

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in business, healthcare administration, public health, clinical operations, analytics, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
- Progressive experience in healthcare program management, clinical operations, population health, value-based care, care-model implementation, product operations, or a comparable environment.
- Demonstrated ownership of a complex program or workstream from design through launch, scale, and performance management.
- Experience leading people, project teams, or cross-functional work through clear objectives, delegation, coaching, and accountability.
- Strong analytical judgment, including the ability to interpret operational and clinical data, identify drivers and risks, and convert findings into action.
- Excellent written and verbal communication, including concise executive-ready synthesis and facilitation of decision-oriented discussions.
- Ability to operate effectively in ambiguity, manage competing priorities, and build alignment without relying solely on formal authority.
- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office; experience working with dashboards, workflow tools, and technology/product partners.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in chronic kidney disease, Medicare Advantage, Stars, kidney value-based care, medication management, care management, or nephrology-facing operations.
- Experience with panel management, population-health workflows, clinical quality improvement, or enterprise-scale change adoption.
- Familiarity with electronic health records, Tableau or comparable BI tools, clinical reporting, requirements definition, and user acceptance testing.
- Experience partnering with frontline clinicians and operators to design workflows that are clinically sound and operationally usable.

Core Leadership Capabilities
DaVita Manager expectation
- Own an aspect of the functional area
- Own CKD MA panel management outcomes, operating model, roadmap, and delivery.
- Translate goals into measurable deliverables
- Convert CKD MA priorities into milestones, targets, management routines, and team objectives.
- Create and maintain a management process
- Establish durable governance, decision, risk, action, and performance-management cadences.
- Lead high-quality synthesis and problem solving
- Frame alternatives, trade-offs, gaps, risks, and recommendations; address barriers before they impair execution.
- Drive change and gain buy-in
- Anticipate field impact, communicate the what/why/how, and reinforce adoption after launch.
- Influence cross-functionally
- Align clinical, operations, analytics, technology, training, market, and payer stakeholders.
- Hire, coach, and manage for performance
- Set expectations, provide timely feedback, develop talent, and connect individual work to program results.

Travel and Other Requirements

- Travel may be required for market launch, workflow observation, training, or stakeholder engagement; final expectation to be confirmed for the requisition.
- Handles confidential business, patient, teammate, and performance information using appropriate discretion and judgment.
- The duties and responsibilities above reflect the general expectations of the role and are not intended to be all-inclusive.

jobs.description:
Posting Date
10/06/2026

2000 16th Street, Denver, Colorado, 80202, United States of America

The Director, Special Projects will serve as a strategic partner to senior leaders, driving high-priority initiatives that support DaVita’s integrated kidney care and procurement strategy, operational performance, clinical outcomes, and enterprise decision-making. This teammate will partner across functions and service lanes to structure ambiguous business challenges, lead complex cross-functional work, synthesize internal and external data, strengthen management processes, and develop executive-ready communications that enable senior leaders to make timely, informed decisions.

Location: Denver-based hybrid role. Travel required up to 25%.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:
- Partner with senior operating and clinical leaders to shape, prioritize, and execute strategic initiatives across the business.
- Lead critical cross-functional projects across multiple service lanes, translating strategy into clear workstreams, milestones, owners, and outcomes.
- Organize and strengthen core operating rhythms, including leadership agendas, decision forums, follow-ups, and accountability mechanisms.
- Identify management process gaps and improvement opportunities, then design and implement practical solutions that improve execution.
- Develop executive-ready materials, leadership readouts, and business communications that clearly frame decisions, risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations.
- Collaborate across teams to perform analyses, synthesize insights, monitor metrics, and prepare recommendations for senior leadership.
- Support internal and external communications by crafting and delivering key messages aligned to business priorities.
- Advance best-in-class capabilities by partnering across operational, clinical, innovation, and functional teams.
- Regularly apprise senior leadership of project status, risks, dependencies, and variations from scope, schedule, or expected impact.
- Contribute to the development and effectiveness of a high-performing leadership team by improving clarity, alignment, and execution discipline.

Strategy & Project Execution:
- Manage and drive strategic and operational initiatives in collaboration with cross-functional partners.
- Structure ambiguous problems into clear workplans, decision points, and execution paths.
- Develop and communicate project scope, timelines, plans, resource needs, assumptions, risks, and dependencies.
- Create, implement, and drive adoption of processes and solutions that further clinical, operational, financial, and business outcomes.
- Manage against targets and goals, including scope, schedule, metrics, financial impact, and stakeholder commitments.
- Scope, plan, and execute multiple high-priority, often quick-turnaround projects with limited oversight.

Education & Experience Requirements:
- Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or graduate degree preferred.
- Minimum of 7 years of experience in strategy, consulting, operations, project leadership, healthcare services, financial operations, or a similar role supporting enterprise-level initiatives.
- Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives with senior leadership visibility and measurable business impact.
- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft 365, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Teams required.
- Prior experience in healthcare services and/or working with payors, physician networks, value-based care models, and/or integrated care models preferred.
- Strong ability to research, analyze, synthesize, and present internal and external data to support executive decision-making.
- Demonstrated track record of top performance and commitment to improving the healthcare system.

Additional Success Factors:
- Highly organized, structured working style with strong project management and execution discipline.
- Strong judgment, discretion, and confidentiality when handling sensitive information.
- Ability to operate effectively in a highly matrixed organization and influence outcomes without direct authority.
- Executive presence, confidence, poise, tact, and diplomacy under pressure.
- Strong analytical, synthesis, storytelling, and presentation skills.
- Self-starter who can work effectively with limited oversight while proactively securing needed access, input, and alignment.
- Resourceful problem solver who can implement effective solutions despite time, information, or resource constraints.
- Exceptional follow-up, follow-through, and attention to detail.
- Comfort with frequent schedule changes, emerging priorities, ambiguity, and quick-turnaround work.
- Results-focused mindset with willingness to do what it takes to move critical work to successful completion.

What We’ll Provide:

More than just pay, our DaVita Rewards package connects teammates to what matters most. Teammates are eligible to begin receiving benefits on the first day of the month following or coinciding with one month of continuous employment. Below are some of our benefit offerings.

- Support for you and your family: Family resources, EAP counseling sessions, access Headspace®, backup child and elder care, maternity/paternity leave and more

jobs.description:
Posting Date
09/29/2026

2476 Swedesford RdSTE 150, Malvern, Pennsylvania, 19355-1456, United States of America

The Role You'd Play:
We are seeking an inspiring and motivated leader who will lead approximately 10 dialysis centers, 200 teammates and provide oversight of operations with complete accountability for approximately $30-$50MM P&L. As a Regional Operations Director (ROD), you'll provide strategic and tactical leadership, counsel, and direction to the field management of those assigned facilities to ensure safe, efficient, therapeutic and ethical patient care.
Additionally, this position identifies and develops strategic growth opportunities, monitors division performance, and works closely with Divisional Vice President or SVP to develop competitive strategies in alignment with DaVita’s mission and values. Position has budget and P&L accountability. This position is a key member of DaVita’s field management team.
Some specific examples include:
- Create a team powerhouse. You'll have approximately 10-12 direct reports you will inspire to join you in the quest to ensure quality and compliant patient care.
- Address top growth priorities, patient census and lead successful operational conversions on acquisitions.
- You will be measured on key metrics and outcomes you are able to drive from the book of business you inherit.
- Develop and execute strategic operating plans and goals for assigned division facilities.
- Meet labor budget.
- Review, analyze, and address gaps in service excellence, policies, and/or procedures proactively; identify issues and implement solutions.
- Manage financial and revenue growth, operations, and labor management, contract management, and clinical outcomes within the assigned division facilities.
- Maintain awareness and knowledge of competition; proactively assess related SWOT (division strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, and threats).
- Lead a growing, socially responsible business that strives to be the role model for American Healthcare.
- Work at a place that gives back to the community .
- Work at a company that honors and rewards teammate for living DaVita's 7 core values: Service Excellence, Integrity, Team, Continuous Improvement, Accountability, Fulfillment and Fun.
- Thrive in a company that will challenge you to "Get Stuff Done" and reward you with incentives the right way - top performers earn more.
- Work directly with FAs in clinics to identify and address employee and patient concerns to drive towards Regional goals and standards

Our most meaningful resource is your passion and vision
If you can see fresh approaches, envision bigger goals to move us ahead and are dedicated to building up those around you… you’ll have our attention! We approach everyday operations with a sharp eye for how to stay on the cutting edge. What we want is sharp executive minds to keep us growing. Our diverse staff hails from a variety of backgrounds, all bringing their valuable perspectives and skills. Here, supporting teammates and their sense of belonging and offering all teammates the opportunity to grow and learn is a priority. We are looking for a candidate that has demonstrated success in the following areas:
- Leadership for a multi-site operational business
- Experience leading a unified team
- Experience identifying and committed to growth in your territory
- Bachelor's degree required, MBA preferred
- Available for moderate travel (25%-50% overnight)
- Philosophies that align with our core values
- Demonstrated understanding of what makes the businesses successful, and able to balance that with patient and teammate satisfaction
- And, a little bit of competitive spirit never hurts

Our investment in you
Our new teammates receive comprehensive training on how DaVita’s dialysis clinics and hospital partnerships operate. You’ll also receive opportunities to partner alongside innovative, compassionate and driven leads as well as access to a comprehensive total rewards package.
Are you ready to transform health care with us?

More than just pay, our DaVita Rewards package connects teammates to what matters most. Teammates are eligible to begin receiving benefits on the first day of the month following or coinciding with one month of continuous employment. Below are some of our benefit offerings.
- Comprehensive benefits: Medical, dental, vision, 401(k) match, paid time off, PTO cash out
- Support for you and your family: Family resources, EAP counseling sessions, access Headspace®, backup child and elder care, maternity/paternity leave and more

- Professional development programs: DaVita offers a variety of programs to help strong performers grow within their career and also offers on-demand virtual leadership and development courses through DaVita’s online training platform StarLearning.

jobs.title: Regional Operations Director (ROD)
jobs.description:
Posting Date
09/23/2026

330 E. Beltline Ave NESuite 310, Grand Rapids, Michigan, 49506, United States of America

The Role You'd Play:

We are seeking an inspiring and motivated leader who will lead approximately 15 dialysis centers, 200 teammates across Ann Arbor, Grand Rapids and South Michigan.  This person will direct operations with complete accountability for an approximately $40-$50MM P&L. As a Regional Operations Director (ROD), you'll provide strategic and tactical leadership, counsel, and direction to the field management of those assigned facilities to ensure safe, efficient, therapeutic and ethical patient care.

Additionally, this position identifies and develops strategic growth opportunities, monitors division performance, and works closely with the Divisional Vice President to develop competitive strategies in alignment with DaVita’s mission and values. Position has budget and P&L accountability. This position is a key member of DaVita’s field management team.

Some specific examples include:

- Leading and growing a high performing team. You'll have approximately 12 direct reports you will inspire to join you in the quest to ensure quality and compliant patient care.

- Identify and lead development and execution of growth strategies.

- You will be measured on key metrics and outcomes you are able to drive.
- Develop and execute strategic operating plans and goals for the region’s facilities.
- Review, analyze, and address gaps in service excellence, policies, and/or procedures proactively; identify issues and implement solutions.
- Lead business growth, operations, and labor management, contract management, and clinical outcomes within the assigned division facilities.
- Maintain awareness and knowledge of competition; proactively assess SWOT (strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, and threats).
- Lead a growing, socially responsible business that strives to be the role model for American Healthcare.
- Work at a place that gives back to the community .
- Work at a company that honors and rewards teammate for living DaVita's 7 core values: Service Excellence, Integrity, Team, Continuous Improvement, Accountability, Fulfillment and Fun.
- Thrive in a company that will challenge you to "Get Stuff Done" and reward you with incentives the right way - top performers earn more.
- Work directly with FAs in clinics to identify and address employee and patient concerns to drive towards Regional goals and standards

Our most meaningful resource is your passion and vision.

If you can see fresh approaches, envision bigger goals to move us ahead and are dedicated to building up those around you… you’ll have our attention! We approach everyday operations with a sharp eye for how to stay on the cutting edge. What we want is sharp executive minds to keep us growing. Our diverse staff hails from a variety of backgrounds, all bringing their valuable perspectives and skills. Here, supporting teammates and their sense of belonging and offering all teammates the opportunity to grow and learn is a priority. We are looking for a candidate that has demonstrated success in the following areas:

133 Limestone Rd, Kenansville, North Carolina, 28349, United States of America

Position: Facility Administrator (FA) - Healthcare Operations Manager

As a Healthcare Operations Manager (Facility Administrator) at DaVita, you’ll be a part of a Team that values work-life balance and where your personal and professional growth is a top priority.

DaVita has an open position for a Healthcare Operations Manager (Facility Administrator) who must be an ambitious, operationally-focused and results-driven leader. You will directly impact patient care as the trusted front-line leader in an outpatient clinic setting. Health care experience is not required!

What you can expect as a Healthcare Operations Manager:
- Patients come first . You have an opportunity to build on your relationship with your patients, while also continuously improving their health through clinical goal setting and quality improvement initiatives.

- Meaningful Workday - EVERY Day. You'll go home every day knowing you are making a difference in patients' lives and that you are developing your team to reach their full potential.

- Available when the clinic is open.

- Lead a Team . Develop, mentor and inspire a cross-functional clinical team (census dependent on state laws) to deliver the best for our patients, teammates and community.

- Financial Management. Manage complete operation and performance of the clinic: adhere to budget, forecast expenses, manage vendor relationships, order supplies, and monitor compliance.

- Autonomy . It's your clinic to run. You aren't alone though. You will have the support and guidance of your director, regional peers and the greater company to help you manage your facility. We foster entrepreneurs and those who seek to continuously improve.

- Culture & Growth . Our values are not just written in a book somewhere, but are an intentional part of everything we do. As leaders, you are able to reward others for demonstrating those shared beliefs and behaviors, and in turn, we intend to do the same for you.

- Partner with Regional Operations Director to identify and address employee and patient concerns to drive towards Regional goals and standards

Now is your time to explore your next journey—at DaVita!!

What you can expect:
- Lead a Team that appreciates, supports and relies on each other in a positive environment.

- Performance-based rewards based on stellar individual and team contributions.

What we'll provide:

DaVita is a clinical leader! We have the highest percentage of facilities meeting or exceeding CMS's standards in the government's two key performance programs. We expect our nurses to commit to improving patient health through clinical goal-setting and quality improvement initiatives.

Comprehensive benefits:
- DaVita offers a competitive total rewards package to connect teammates to what matters most.

- We offer medical, dental, vision, 401k match, paid time off, PTO cash out, paid training and more.

- DaVita provides the opportunities for support for you and your family with family resources, EAP counseling sessions, access to Headspace®, backup child, elder care, maternity/paternity leave, pet insurance and so much more!

Requirements:
- Associates degree preferred, unless required by state or local laws; Bachelor's degree in related area strongly preferred

- Minimum of one year experience required in management (healthcare, business, or military) or equivalent renal experience (nurse, dietitian, social worker, LPN, etc.) at discretion of DVP and/or ROD

- Current license to practice as a Registered Nurse if required by state of employment

- Current CPR certification required (or certification must be obtained within 60 days of hire or change in position)

- Other qualifications and combinations of skills may be considered at discretion of ROD and/or Divisional Vice President

- Collaboration is a much to be successful in this role. You will be working with clinical and financial teams on a daily basis to produce results that align to business needs.

- Intermediate computer skills and proficiency in MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook required.

jobs.description:

24 MacCorkle Ave SW, South Charleston, West Virginia, 25303-1476, United States of America

Over the last decade, we set out to be the world's greatest dialysis company, and over the next decade, we're poised to build the greatest healthcare community the world has ever seen. When you join the DaVita Village, you're joining a winning team. Through our commitment to training, growth and quality, we consistently achieve superior clinical outcomes while giving teammates the opportunity to excel in an award-winning environment that enables them to thrive both professionally and personally.

Regional Director Operations – Clinical Services & Operations
This role is a unique hybrid, functioning in a dual capacity as both the operational leader (ROD) and the clinical leader (MCS) for the region. The Regional Operations Director (Clinical Services) is responsible for the overall operational, financial, and clinical management of the region. They will drive business outcomes and strategic growth while ensuring the highest standards of patient care, safety, quality assurance, and regulatory compliance.

Geography includes rural West Virginia and Eastern Kentucky (6 clinics total). Relocation eligibility is available for qualified candidates.

This leader partners with Divisional and Regional Operations leadership to align clinical strategy with performance priorities. Beyond setting direction, the Regional Director is accountable for execution—ensuring strict adherence to quality improvement plans, regulatory compliance, and operational KPIs. Success in this role is defined by the ability to stabilize variance, drive consistency, and deliver sustained improvements in patient care and safety across the region.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:
- Clinical Leadership & Quality Assurance: Oversee nursing and technical services for patient treatment. Conduct trend analysis of clinical outcomes and independently develop and implement plans of correction for any clinical quality issues. Ensure adherence to all state and federal regulations governing patient care services (HIPAA, CMS, OSHA, etc.).
- Operations & Financial Management: Manage regional P&L, budget forecasting, and inventory to optimize financial performance and strategic growth.
- Teammate Management: Provide leadership and mentorship to facility administrators and clinical teams. Direct all teammate activity including hiring, promoting, performance development reviews (PDRs), and disciplinary actions. Foster a positive, inclusive work culture aligned with DaVita's Core Values.
- Physician & Patient Relations: Foster strong strategic relationships with nephrologists, medical directors, and hospital partners. Ensure comprehensive modality education and exceptional patient care experiences.

Education & Requirements:
- Current license to practice as a Registered Nurse (RN) in the state of employment is REQUIRED .

- Bachelor’s degree in a related area strongly preferred.
- Minimum of two (2) years of healthcare management experience preferred; multi-facility dialysis management experience strongly preferred.
- Current CPR certification required.
- Intermediate computer skills and proficiency in DaVita clinical applications (CWOW, etc.).

Here is what you can expect when you join our Village:
• A "community first, company second" culture based on Core Values that really matter.
• Clinical outcomes consistently ranked above the national average.
• Award-winning education and training across multiple career paths to help you reach your potential.
• Performance-based rewards based on stellar individual and team contributions.
• A comprehensive benefits package designed to enhance your health, your financial well-being and your future.

Over the last decade, we set out to be the world's greatest dialysis company, and over the next decade, we're poised to build the greatest healthcare community the world has ever seen. When you join the DaVita Village, you're joining a winning team. Through our commitment to training, growth and quality, we consistently achieve superior clinical outcomes while giving teammates the opportunity to excel in an award-winning environment that enables them to thrive both professionally and personally.

Position Overview
- Department: Team Pegasus (Corporate Development & Growth)
- Location: Remote; assigned regional territory encompassing approximately 50% of DaVita’s Titan Operating Group footprint across the Mid-Atlantic and Upper South (spanning MD, DC, DE, VA, NC, KY, and WV). Final sub-regional territory and divisional alignment will be determined based on candidate profile, expertise, and geographic location.
- Travel: Approximately 30%–50% regional travel

About Team Pegasus

Team Pegasus serves as DaVita’s dedicated growth and business development engine, driving physician alignment, strategic partnerships, joint ventures, acquisitions, and market development across the country.  As a Business Development Director, you will serve as the strategic growth leader, deal originator, and acquisition driver for an assigned regional portfolio covering approximately half of DaVita’s Titan Operating Group (encompassing major markets across MD, DC, DE, VA, NC, KY, and WV). In close partnership with operational leadership, you will design and execute data-driven market strategies, actively identify, source, and execute acquisitions, build lasting relationships with nephrologists and health systems, and navigate complex transactions to expand care across the community.

1. Acquisition Origination & Deal Execution
- Target Sourcing & Pipeline Management: Proactively identify, originate, and build a robust pipeline of acquisition opportunities (independent dialysis clinics, physician practice assets, and joint venture opportunities) across assigned geographies.
- Transaction Execution: Lead deals through the entire transaction lifecycle—from initial target outreach, preliminary financial analysis, and due diligence through LOI negotiation, deal structuring, and definitive agreements in close partnership with Deal Depot and Corporate Development.
- Deal Navigation & Closing: Anticipate and resolve roadblocks (physician dynamics, regulatory hurdles including CON, valuation complexities) to ensure timely and accretive deal closures.

2. Market Growth Strategy & Intelligence
- Divisional Strategy & Goal Setting: Develop and execute multi-year growth plans for assigned divisions and markets to achieve targeted census growth, market share, and clinical reach.
- Market Analytics & Mapping: Conduct in-depth market scans, whitespace assessments, and physician supply/demand analyses to identify high-impact expansion opportunities.
- Competitive Intelligence: Monitor and evaluate competitor activity, market consolidation, and shifting provider affiliations, translating insights into proactive growth countermeasures.

3. Physician & Health System Partnerships
- Nephrology Relationship Development: Cultivate trusted, high-impact relationships with independent nephrology groups, health system leaders, and key practice decision-makers.
- Strategic Partnerships & Governance: Source and structure physician alignment models, including Medical Director Agreements (MDAs), Joint Ventures (JVs), and Value-Based Care (VBC) arrangements.
- Executive Framing & Influence: Tailor strategic messaging and business rationale to external clinical leaders, aligning physician practice goals with DaVita’s clinical and operational capabilities.

4. Operational Partnership & Matrix Leadership
- Field Partnership: Collaborate seamlessly with Division Vice Presidents (DVPs), Regional Operations Directors (RODs), Field Strategy, and Finance partners to integrate growth plans into local operating rhythms.
- Coaching & Upskilling: Act as a subject matter expert and coach for operational peers building collective capability around physician engagement and growth dynamics.
- Cross-Lane Alignment: Lead through influence across clinical, legal, regulatory, and finance lanes to align internal stakeholders around deal execution and strategic priorities.

5. Culture, Compliance & Initiative Leadership
- Lead the DaVita Way: Champion DaVita’s core values (Service Excellence, Integrity, Team, Continuous Improvement, Accountability, Fulfillment, and Fun), fostering a collaborative and high-performing culture.
- Compliance & Partner Selection: Ensure strict adherence to DaVita’s healthcare compliance standards, partner selection criteria, and regulatory mandates across all deals and provider interactions.
- Continuous Improvement: Identify market-level operational or growth friction points, develop innovative solutions, and actively contribute to national Pegasus initiatives and strategic workstreams.

Qualifications & Candidate Profile
- Education: Bachelor’s degree required; MBA, MHA, or equivalent master’s degree strongly preferred.
- Experience: 5+ years of progressive experience in healthcare business development, corporate development/M&A, healthcare management consulting, physician practice management, or healthcare operations.
- Acquisition & Deal Track Record: Demonstrated success originating, evaluating, negotiating, and closing healthcare transactions, joint ventures, or strategic partnerships.
- Financial Acumen: Strong commercial and financial competence, including experience analyzing pro formas, deal models, and P&L dynamics.
- Strategic Influence: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to build immediate credibility with C-suite executives, physician leaders, and internal executive partners.
- Results Orientation: High degree of self-direction, resourcefulness, and resilience in navigating long-cycle, multi-stakeholder deals.
- Travel Flexibility: Willingness to travel 30%–50% within assigned multi-state territory for partner meetings, physician dinners, and clinic visits.

No Brag, Just Fact!

Over the last decade, we set out to be the world's greatest dialysis company, and over the next decade, we're poised to build the greatest healthcare community the world has ever seen. When you join the DaVita Village, you're joining a winning team. About Team Pegasus

Team Pegasus serves as DaVita’s dedicated growth and business development engine, driving physician alignment, strategic partnerships, joint ventures, acquisitions, and market development across the country.  As a Business Development Director, you will serve as the strategic growth leader, deal originator, and acquisition driver for an assigned regional portfolio covering approximately half of DaVita’s Titan Operating Group (encompassing major markets across MD, DC, DE, VA, NC, KY, and WV). In close partnership with operational leadership, you will design and execute data-driven market strategies, actively identify, source, and execute acquisitions, build lasting relationships with nephrologists and health systems, and navigate complex transactions to expand care across the community.

1. Acquisition Origination & Deal Execution
- Target Sourcing & Pipeline Management: Proactively identify, originate, and build a robust pipeline of acquisition opportunities (independent dialysis clinics, physician practice assets, and joint venture opportunities) across assigned geographies.

2. Market Growth Strategy & Intelligence
- Divisional Strategy & Goal Setting: Develop and execute multi-year growth plans for assigned divisions and markets to achieve targeted census growth, market share, and clinical reach.
- Market Analytics & Mapping: Conduct in-depth market scans, whitespace assessments, and physician supply/demand analyses to identify high-impact expansion opportunities.
- Competitive Intelligence: Monitor and evaluate competitor activity, market consolidation, and shifting provider affiliations, translating insights into proactive growth countermeasures.

3. Physician & Health System Partnerships
- Nephrology Relationship Development: Cultivate trusted, high-impact relationships with independent nephrology groups, health system leaders, and key practice decision-makers.
- Strategic Partnerships & Governance: Source and structure physician alignment models, including Medical Director Agreements (MDAs), Joint Ventures (JVs), and Value-Based Care (VBC) arrangements.
- Executive Framing & Influence: Tailor strategic messaging and business rationale to external clinical leaders, aligning physician practice goals with DaVita’s clinical and operational capabilities.

4. Operational Partnership & Matrix Leadership
- Field Partnership: Collaborate seamlessly with Division Vice Presidents (DVPs), Regional Operations Directors (RODs), Field Strategy, and Finance partners to integrate growth plans into local operating rhythms.
- Coaching & Upskilling: Act as a subject matter expert and coach for operational peers building collective capability around physician engagement and growth dynamics.
- Cross-Lane Alignment: Lead through influence across clinical, legal, regulatory, and finance lanes to align internal stakeholders around deal execution and strategic priorities.

5. Culture, Compliance & Initiative Leadership
- Lead the DaVita Way: Champion DaVita’s core values (Service Excellence, Integrity, Team, Continuous Improvement, Accountability, Fulfillment, and Fun), fostering a collaborative and high-performing culture.
- Compliance & Partner Selection: Ensure strict adherence to DaVita’s healthcare compliance standards, partner selection criteria, and regulatory mandates across all deals and provider interactions.
- Continuous Improvement: Identify market-level operational or growth friction points, develop innovative solutions, and actively contribute to national Pegasus initiatives and strategic workstreams.

Qualifications & Candidate Profile
- Education: Bachelor’s degree required; MBA, MHA, or equivalent master’s degree strongly preferred.
- Experience: 5+ years of progressive experience in healthcare business development, corporate development/M&A, healthcare management consulting, physician practice management, or healthcare operations.
- Acquisition & Deal Track Record: Demonstrated success originating, evaluating, negotiating, and closing healthcare transactions, joint ventures, or strategic partnerships.
- Financial Acumen: Strong commercial and financial competence, including experience analyzing pro formas, deal models, and P&L dynamics.
- Strategic Influence: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to build immediate credibility with C-suite executives, physician leaders, and internal executive partners.
- Results Orientation: High degree of self-direction, resourcefulness, and resilience in navigating long-cycle, multi-stakeholder deals.
- Travel Flexibility: Willingness to travel 30%–50% within assigned multi-state territory for partner meetings, physician dinners, and clinic visits.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Strategic Growth & Business Development
jobs.description:
Posting Date
09/09/2026

4451 Parliament PlaceSuite T, Lanham, Maryland, 20706, United States of America

No Brag, Just Fact!

Over the last decade, we set out to be the world's greatest dialysis company, and over the next decade, we're poised to build the greatest healthcare community the world has ever seen. When you join the DaVita Village, you're joining a winning team. Through our commitment to training, growth and quality, we consistently achieve superior clinical outcomes while giving teammates the opportunity to excel in an award-winning environment that enables them to thrive both professionally and personally.

Position Overview: Senior Director, Strategic Growth & Business Development
- Department: Team Pegasus (Corporate Development & Growth)
- Location: Remote; assigned regional territory encompassing large, complex, and high-impact operating group footprints across DaVita's Titan Operating Group (spanning MD, DC, DE, VA, NC, KY, and WV). Final sub-regional territory and divisional alignment determined based on candidate profile, expertise, and strategic market priorities.
- Travel: Approximately 30%–50% regional travel

About Team Pegasus

Team Pegasus serves as DaVita's dedicated growth and business development engine, driving physician alignment, strategic partnerships, joint ventures, acquisitions, and market development across the country.

As a Senior Business Development Director, you will serve as a premier strategic growth leader, senior deal originator, and trusted advisor across high-impact and highly complex regional portfolios within DaVita's Titan Operating Group. In close partnership with senior operational executives (DVPs, GVPs, and RODs) and as a credible extension of executive leadership, you will design and execute sophisticated, multi-year market strategies, originate and close high-value transactions, foster deep clinical and health system partnerships, and lead cross-functional action teams to accelerate clinical reach and sustainable growth across the Village.

Key Responsibilities & Core Competencies

1. High-Impact Deal Origination & Complex Transaction Execution
- Strategic Target Origination: Proactively source, originate, and build a high-conviction pipeline of high-impact acquisition opportunities, including multi-site independent dialysis clinics, physician practice assets, and strategic joint ventures across priority geographies.
- Complex Deal Structuring & Execution: Lead end-to-end deal lifecycles for high-complexity, large-scale, and strategic transactions—from outreach, valuation, and due diligence through LOI negotiation, deal structuring, and definitive legal agreements in collaboration with Deal Depot and Operations.
- Risk Mitigation & Deal Navigation: Proactively identify transaction risks, regulatory hurdles (including Certificate of Need / CON requirements), and physician dynamics, navigating roadblocks effectively and negotiating solutions to ensure value-accretive, compliant closings.

2. Strategic Thinking, Market Intelligence & Value Creation
- Enterprise Growth Strategy: Architect and lead multi-year market strategies across divisions to achieve targeted census expansion, clinical reach, and market share.
- Smart Bets & Resource Allocation: Place calculated, data-driven bets to drive long-term enterprise value; allocate personal and cross-functional partner resources toward highest-value priorities.
- Market Mapping & Whitespace Optimization: Direct advanced whitespace assessments, physician supply/demand mapping, and competitive analyses to forecast consolidation trends and build offensive and defensive market strategies.
- Strategic Misalignment Resolution: Resolve complex misalignments in market prioritization or risk appetite across operational, clinical, and finance leadership to align teams behind unified growth plans.

3. Physician, Health System & Executive Partnerships
- Strategic Nephrology Alignment: Cultivate enduring, C-suite and senior-level relationships with large independent nephrology groups, health system executives, and regional healthcare leaders.
- Innovative Alignment Models: Source, design, and structure sophisticated alignment frameworks, including Medical Director Agreements (MDAs), complex Joint Ventures (JVs), and Value-Based Care (VBC) / integrated kidney care models.
- Executive Presence & Influence: Serve as a credible extension of the executive leadership team, framing complex concepts with clarity and tailoring high-stakes strategic rationale to physician boards, health system C-suites, and internal senior executives.

4. Matrix Leadership, Operational Partnership & Team Development
- Executive Operational Partnership: Act as a strategic thought partner to Group Vice Presidents (GVPs), Division Vice Presidents (DVPs), Regional Operations Directors (RODs), Field Strategy, and Finance partners, seamlessly integrating growth initiatives into core operating rhythms.
- Constructive Influence & Courageous Communication: Communicate complex strategic concepts with precision; demonstrate the capability and composure to respectfully challenge and align perspectives with DVP and GVP partners.
- Mentorship & Talent Development: Directly and indirectly lead, mentor, and upskill talent across the growth ecosystem—including Physician Relationship Managers (PRMs), Redwoods leadership fellows, Pegasus Directors, Special Ops, and cross-functional action teams.
- Cross-Lane Matrix Leadership: Drive accountability and alignment across legal, regulatory, compliance, finance, and clinical lanes to streamline execution.

5. Culture, Change Leadership & Villagewide Impact (GRSD & DaVita Way)
- Lead the DaVita Way: Serve as an active cultural champion of DaVita's core values (Service Excellence, Integrity, Team, Continuous Improvement, Accountability, Fulfillment, and Fun), intentionally designing collaborative ways of working that foster trust, inclusion, and belonging.
- Conflict Mediation: Proactively mediate complex stakeholder conflicts across internal lanes and external partners to protect critical relationships and accelerate deal outcomes.
- Villagewide Change Initiatives: Lead and contribute to major Villagewide action teams, special initiatives, and strategic workstreams that shape national Pegasus standards and broader Village growth playbooks.
- Proactive Risk Management & Compliance: Identify broader organizational and market-level risks across operating groups, establishing robust mitigation plans while upholding the highest standards of healthcare compliance and partner selection criteria.

Qualifications & Candidate Profile

- Education: Bachelor's degree required; MBA, MHA, or equivalent master's degree strongly preferred.
- Experience: 8+ years of progressive experience in healthcare business development, corporate development / M&A, healthcare investment banking / private equity, healthcare management consulting, or senior physician practice/operations leadership.
- Senior Deal Track Record: Demonstrated track record of independently originating, structuring, negotiating, and executing large, high-complexity healthcare M&A transactions, joint ventures, or strategic health system alliances.
- Financial & Commercial Mastery: Advanced financial acumen with extensive experience modeling complex deal structures, evaluating pro formas, assessing enterprise risk, and optimizing P&L impact.
- Executive Influence & Thought Partnership: Proven ability to command credibility as an executive peer, engaging and influencing C-suite executives, physician practice owners, health system boards, and internal executive vice presidents.
- People Leadership & Coaching: Demonstrated success leading and developing direct reports or cross-functional matrixed teams (e.g., junior deal leads, operational partners, leadership development fellows).
- Adaptability & Resilience: Superior judgment, resourcefulness, and emotional intelligence in navigating long-cycle, politically nuanced, and multi-stakeholder healthcare environments.

Travel Flexibility: Willingness to travel 30%–50% within assigned regional territory for partner meetings, physician dinners, site visits, and executive sessions.

Here is what you can expect when you join our Village:
- A "community first, company second" culture based on Core Values that really matter.
- Clinical outcomes consistently ranked above the national average.
- Award-winning education and training across multiple career paths to help you reach your potential.
- Performance-based rewards based on stellar individual and team contributions.
- A comprehensive benefits package designed to enhance your health, your financial well-being and your future.
- Dedication, above all, to caring for patients suffering from chronic kidney failure across the nation.

The Manager, Strategic Sourcing – Pharmaceuticals position will lead category management efforts with a primary focus on pharmaceutical products, while also supporting other direct procurement categories critical to kidney care delivery (e.g., branded, generic, injectables, and specialty drugs; and devices, solutions, and ancillaries), with responsibility for direct sourcing and category management across chronic care, acute and home modalities.  This role will collaborate closely with clinical teams, finance, legal, and pharmacy operations to shape and implement sourcing strategies that ensure product availability, manage cost, and mitigate risk in a highly regulated environment.  The ideal candidate will bring a deep understanding of the pharmaceutical and health care supply chain, strong negotiation and contracting skills, and a bias toward execution.
